statusDetail: The economics digital library, teaching materials, and experiment services remain online.

continuityNote: Use the surviving IUCN page as the current authoritative reference. Treat the book-era project domain as historical until a current operator confirms otherwise.

statusDetail: The surviving primary evaluation documents AnthroCommons as a virtual conference facility created for the 2004 AAA Annual Meeting; no current operating AnthroCommons site was verified.

operator: Consortium Érudit: Université de Montréal, Université Laval, and Université du Québec à Montréal
statusDetail: The scholarly publishing and dissemination platform remains active.
